intent: Check the specified gap between body and wing at a low display resolution.

context.mask_definition: binary object-ID silhouette; no bloom or AA

metric.definition: The number of empty pixel columns between the right edge of Body and the left edge of Wing on the y=96 scanline of the ROI. Both edges must be present.

constraints.description: The camera, internal resolution and pose are held; no claim is made to have measured every gap outside the defined ROI.

acceptance.description: Check whether that gap actually helps separate the targets. 2px is not a universal readability criterion for every screen.

note: The numbers and target names are a serialization example. They are not recommended thresholds, real assets, or verified results.
